data.title: 八奈见杏菜 · 海边薯条防波堤
data.description: 【海滨餐车沙滩·正午】杏菜穿着蓝色泳装坐在防波堤上，怀里抱着一大盒薯条和冰茶；海风吹走一张餐巾，她伸手按住食物，随后把最大的一根薯条朝镜头递来，眼神写满“这是最甜的一根”。
data.action: 防波堤上护住薯条不被海风吹走，挑出最大一根递给镜头
data.lighting: bright noon light with crisp wave sparkle
data.mood: 食物与假日都要大份的活力
data.promptProse: Anna Yanami from Too Many Losing Heroines! wears a bright blue swimsuit with a white overshirt, striped sun hat and an oversized box of fries. She sits on the seawall guarding a huge box of fries from the ocean breeze. She catches the flying napkin with one hand, then offers the largest fry toward the viewer with a generous grin while iced tea and sunlit waves share the frame. bright noon light with crisp wave sparkle.
